sloka: ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणाम् सम्जज्ञे निःस्वनो महान् ।तुमुलः शङ्खशब्दश्च सभाम् गच्चति रवणे ॥६-११-९॥।।
transliteration: tatastūryasahasrāṇām samjajñe niḥsvano mahān ।tumulaḥ śaṅkhaśabdaśca sabhām gaccati ravaṇe ॥6-11-9॥।।

translations.english: Then as Ravana entered the assembly thousands of band instruments sounded aloud. Conchs broke forth producing tumultuous noise.
